sources.snippet: We present Stable Fast 3D (SF3D) - a feed-forward 3D asset generation model , which generates UV-unwrapped, textured models with material parameters and delit albedo in under a second. Utilizing the Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) as its foundation, SF3D achieves impressive performance, reconstructing detailed, textured meshes in just 0.5 seconds.
